messages:
rohit: heads up — incoming onboarding request from AcmePayments. They want an instruct-style variant derived from an open 7b, 200k context, prefer int8 quant, must include per-request PII redaction. POC target: Dedicated in ~2 weeks. can we triage?

emma: thanks. do we have a specific base model name from them or a weights link? any license constraints?

rohit: they linked to: https://models.acme/open-7b-instruct-v1 (customer-hosted tarball). License looks permissive but needs legal signoff. they emphasized fidelity on instructions and low hallucination.

liz: 200k context is large — only our longctx path supports that. which longctx mode do they expect? sliding window or segmented KV?

rohit: they asked for full 200k prefix with retrieval-like access patterns. they'd like prefix caching + chunked attention.

devon: ok triage notes: 1) weights ingestion + convert to our HF->runtime bridge. 2) baseline float16 run w/ 200k tokens (smoke perf) 3) run PTQ int8 sweep (`q8_0`, `q8_1`) and compare quality vs fp16 4) eval on their prompt set (privacy-sensitive finance Qs) 5) redaction middleware integration + audit logs 6) rollout/canary plan.

emma: can we commit to the 2 week POC? devon, how long for ingestion + float16 baseline?

devon: ingestion + convert: ~2 days. baseline longctx perf: ~1 day (but needs a node with 512GB mem). int8 sweep + eval: another 3-4 days depending on runs. overall ~7-9 working days if infra available.

liz: infra note — Dedicated pool we'll need for POC. request quota to eng-infra, and pin a 4xA40 or equivalent with NVLink for long kv.

qa: also need quality/regression checklist: - overlap with our anchor eval set (billing prompts) - hallucination metrics (Factuality P@K) - instruction-following score (winograd/LLM-adapted) - latency/cost per 1k tokens. I can start writing eval harness.

rohit: customer will provide their own prompt corpus (10k queries). we'll run both their tests and our anchors.

emma: good. I'll draft a prioritized backlog: 1) legal check (weights license) 2) infra reservation + ingestion 3) fp16 baseline + basic correctness 4) int8 sweep (q8_0, q8_1) + compare on anchor set 5) redaction integration 6) canary deploy on Dedicated w/ fallback to hosted model.

devon: small helper snippet for local eval runners (paste into job):
```
# run longctx baseline
python -m ri_eval.runner \
  --model weights/open-7b-instruct --ctx 200000 \
  --quant none --batch 1 --out baseline.json

# int8 sweep
for q in q8_0 q8_1; do
  python -m ri_eval.runner --model conv/$q --ctx 200000 --batch 1 --out ${q}.json
done
```

liz: perf expectations: fp16 p50 token latency ~55-80ms for 7b w/ longctx on A40 NVLink (depends a lot on KV cache hit). int8 might save ~25-40% cost but could regress instruction-following. need eval gates.

qa: propose pass/fail thresholds for canary: instruction-following > 92% relative to fp16 baseline, hallucination delta < 3% absolute, latency p50 < 120ms. if fail, block canary.

rohit: the customer also asked about an 'instruct vs base' option — they might want both. supporting both increases storage + testing. any preference?

emma: recommend we prioritize instruct variant first (they asked that). base -> instruct fine later if needed. keep variant naming convention `acme/open-7b-instruct-rw-v1` for clarity.

devon: FYI quantization plan: start with PTQ q8_0, if we see big regressions, consider QAT or hybrid QAT on critical layers. that adds ~1 week.

liz: I'll open infra ticket. rohit, can you upload their tarball to staging and share creds? ops-bot: create ticket for infra?

ops-bot: ✅ created BRNG-3421 (dedicated-infra reserve) and INGEST-778 (weights ingestion).

rohit: uploaded staging link to S3: s3://redwood-staging/acme/open-7b-instruct-v1.tar.gz (share with legal and devon).

emma: QA — start authoring anchor eval + redaction testcases. devon/liz — sync on infra constraints tomorrow 10am PT. rohit — get legal looped.

devon: noted. will run quick fp16 smoke tonight and post logs.

qa: adding a small interactive eval note: for PII redaction we should include masked prompts and assert redaction token spans + audit log entries.

rohit: thanks all. I'll summarize into a short intake doc and hand off to eng-sre/dedicated onboarding. :thumbsup: 

liz: thanks — marking as high priority. :white_check_mark:
